kind: Stylized medieval strategy-map diorama with graphic map pins and educational plate framing
regions: central lake and eastern settlement with windmills
southwestern sand and foreground adobe village

assets.conifers: hundreds, grouped into visually matched groves

materials: white faceted snow with blue-gray crevices
relations: Mountain closes rear of map; rivers leave its left and front foothills
Main lake occupies center and feeds foreground and right-edge branches
Road network threads all village clusters, crossing rivers at several points
West village surrounds small market green
Eastern mills face the path beside pond
Adobe houses cluster on both banks of foreground river

integration.root: camera, lights, background, pins, border labels, legend, assembly and continuity
integration.terrain: all terrain, water, mountain, vegetation and natural small detail
integration.settlements: all architecture, roads, bridges, fences, lamps, stalls and human props
